description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, a UI density setting, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin), Send to car from phone Maps, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, and a safe mode with feature switches. BYD battery, Send to car and the BYD location flicker fix are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Adds a UI density setting, a problem report and a safe mode.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to Maps Car through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links).

release_notes:
- Fixes a crash on Android 10 when Maps starts spoken directions with its online voice, for example with the head unit set to English (#1).
- The report app is now **Report Maps Car**, with a red icon of its own.
- Reports now include the warning and error lines Maps Car wrote to the system log even when nothing crashed, the memory page size and the car platform. On Android 11 and newer they also say why Maps Car last closed. Long ID numbers are now removed before the preview, like locations and e-mail addresses. If Maps Car stays on a grey screen, send the report before you restart the head unit.
- BYD battery: the arrival estimate no longer climbs and drops by about a point with every percent of battery.
- Moves to MicroG-RE 7.3.0. The README and the app's download link now point to it.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Other BYD models are untested, BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i), and the Android 11 part of the report has not run on a car yet.

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
